_why: WARLOCK PACT MAGIC POOL BUG (2026-11-12): Hex, Arms of Hadar, Armor of Agathys and Hellish Rebuke gated and spent from the bare warlock_spell_slots (1st-level pool), which permanently zeroes at warlock level 3+ once everything moves to warlock_spell_slots_max_2. A level 3+ warlock with a full 2nd-level pool could never cast any of the four. Fixed via spend_pact_slot (combat_spells.txt) and widened gates. This fixture is the regression check: level 3 warlock, 1st-level pool at its post-collapse zero, 2nd-level pool full, Hex must still be offered and must spend from the 2nd-level pool.
